aspecttable.name: C&O 1943 Piedmont/Mountain Sub Color-Light
aspecttable.reference: Adapted from the AAR 1946 recommended aspect/indication set, which C&O's own rulebook of this era closely tracked (as did most eastern roads by WWII). Physical hardware (three-lamp AC color-light, not searchlight) is documented for Gordonsville-Charlottesville- Staunton-Clifton Forge (ICC Order 1/2 ATC territory, installed 1919-1926) via period Railway Signaling / Railway Age articles. Richmond-Gordonsville (including Louisa) is separately documented only as "Automatic Block Territory" from the early 1900s; the source consulted did not confirm whether that stretch carries the same color-light hardware as of 1943, or older semaphore hardware not yet converted. THIS FILE ASSUMES COLOR-LIGHT THROUGHOUT and should be checked against a period C&O employee timetable, rulebook, or C&OHS reference for the Richmond-Gordonsville segment specifically, and for exact rule numbers/wording, before treating it as prototypically final.

This is a hand-built starting point, not an official JMRI-distributed system. It has not been loaded/validated in JMRI yet - use Debug -> "Validate XML File" the first time you load it, and expect to need small fixes.

aspect.name: Clear
aspect.description: Block(s) ahead clear, route set for normal speed through any diverging turnouts ahead.

aspect.name: Approach Medium
aspect.indication: Proceed, be prepared to pass next signal at medium speed
aspect.description: Next signal will be Medium Clear or more restrictive; be prepared to take a diverging route at the next interlocking at medium speed.

aspect.name: Medium Clear
aspect.indication: Proceed at medium speed, route diverging
aspect.description: Train is taking a diverging (turnout) route at this signal; block(s) ahead clear beyond the diverging move.

aspect.name: Approach
aspect.indication: Proceed prepared to stop at next signal
aspect.description: Next signal displays Stop or Stop and Proceed; reduce to be able to stop at it.

aspect.name: Medium Approach
aspect.indication: Proceed at medium speed, prepared to stop at next signal
aspect.description: Diverging route at this signal, next signal displays Stop or Stop and Proceed.

aspect.name: Restricting
aspect.description: Proceed prepared to stop short of train, obstruction, or improperly lined switch; used at some interlocking dwarfs and for permissive moves.

aspect.name: Stop and Proceed
aspect.indication: Stop, then proceed at restricted speed
aspect.description: Used at automatic (non-interlocking) block signals only - stop, then proceed at restricted speed prepared to stop short of train or obstruction.

aspect.name: Stop
aspect.description: Used at interlocking home/absolute signals. Stop and stay stopped unless/until authorized to proceed.
